insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update is available as of September 9, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure it accounts for the new tax recalculation behavior. This change may impact custom tax calculation logic or integrations with third-party tax services. Developers can use the orderUpdate mutation with the new shipping address to trigger the tax recalculation. No additional fields are required in the mutation, but the response will include the updated tax amounts.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses for unfulfilled orders, which can help reduce errors and improve compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and reduces the risk of errors or non-compliance with tax regulations. It also simplifies the development process by eliminating the need for custom tax calculation logic in many cases.

CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, providing more flexibility when importing orders.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated to better reflect how fulfillment operations run in practice.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, to extend the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data, UI extensions, and storefront events

themes.title: Performance Data and Analytics
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enables more informed decision-making for merchants.

themes.title: Storefront and UI Extensions
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support has been added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts. These updates improve the overall shopping experience and enable more seamless interactions between merchants and customers.

themes.title: Development and Inventory Management
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. Additionally, draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed, streamlining inventory management.
